panels.title: New collections · records
panels.description: Object records in every collection flagged as new (new_collection = true on the collname record). Ignores the filters above.

panels.title: Transfer collections · records
panels.description: Object records in every collection not flagged as new. Ignores the filters above.

panels.title: All object records
panels.description: Total records in the objects database, whether or not they belong to a collection.

panels.title: Records not in any collection
panels.description: Object records with no collection.name. Approximate: a record in two collections counts twice in the sum.

panels.title: New collections
panels.description: Number of collections flagged as new.

panels.title: Added to new · in range
panels.description: Records added to new collections over the selected time range.

panels.title: Transfer collections
panels.description: Number of transfer collections.

panels.title: Added to transfer · in range
panels.description: Records added to transfer collections over the selected time range.

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: Whether the last refresh from the Axiell API succeeded.

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Time since the exporter last refreshed successfully from the API.

panels.title: New collections
panels.description: Records in each new collection, largest first.

panels.title: Transfer collections
panels.description: Records in each transfer collection, largest first. Empty bars are collections with no records yet.

panels.title: Records by type
panels.description: Total records in new and transfer collections over time.

panels.title: Records added per day
panels.description: Net records added each day, by collection type. Needs a day of history. Negative values mean records were deleted or moved.

panels.title: Records by collection
panels.description: Records in each collection over time. Use the filters above to narrow it down.

panels.title: Collections
panels.description: Every collection with its type, record count, share of all collection records, and change over the selected range.

targets.expr: max by (collection, institution, type) (axiell_collection_records{institution=~"$institution", type=~"$type", collection=~"$collection"})
100 * max by (collection, institution, type) (axiell_collection_records{institution=~"$institution", type=~"$type", collection=~"$collection"}) / scalar(sum(axiell_collection_records))

max by (collection, institution, type) ((axiell_collection_records{institution=~"$institution", type=~"$type", collection=~"$collection"} - axiell_collection_records{institution=~"$institution", type=~"$type", collection=~"$collection"} offset $__range) or (axiell_collection_records{institution=~"$institution", type=~"$type", collection=~"$collection"} - min_over_time(axiell_collection_records{institution=~"$institution", type=~"$type", collection=~"$collection"}[$__range])))

panels.title: API refresh duration
panels.description: How long each refresh from the Axiell API takes.

panels.title: API refresh failures
panels.description: Failed refreshes. The dashboard keeps showing the last good numbers during failures.

panels.title: Hourly · last success
panels.description: Age of the newest successful hourly backup on wooster-db. Amber past 2h, red past 4h.

panels.title: Daily · last success
panels.description: Age of the newest successful daily backup on wooster-db. Amber past 26h, red past 48h.

panels.title: Weekly · last success
panels.description: Age of the newest successful weekly backup on wooster-db. Amber past 192h, red past 336h.

panels.title: Full · last success
panels.description: Age of the newest successful full backup on wooster-db. Amber past 192h, red past 336h.

panels.title: Time since last successful backup
panels.description: Each schedule should saw up and drop back to zero when it runs. A line that keeps climbing is a schedule that has stopped. Filter with the backup_type variable.

panels.title: Offsite copy to Azure · azcopy sync
Last sync finished
panels.description: Age of the last completed azcopy run to the nibackups container.

panels.title: Failed transfers
panels.description: Anything above zero means part of the last sync did not reach Azure.

panels.title: Deletions at destination
panels.description: This sync runs with --delete-destination=true, so it is a mirror: files deleted locally are deleted in Azure too. A non-zero number here is the offsite copy shrinking. Check it was deliberate. See known-gaps row 2.

panels.title: Source − destination
panels.description: Files present locally but not yet in Azure. Should settle at zero.

title: Axiell Datasets
description: Axiell Collections record counts per collection, split into new and transfer collections.
